scope: Frozen ordinary nonfoil inventories for LEA, LEB, 3ED, 8ED and M21; current runtime selectors on the 0.4.1-derived early-expansion branch. Special layouts and variant treatments are outside these counts.
policy: The current frame flag indicates some pigment coverage, not full calibration of every component or measured accuracy.
Printing colors, mana-disc colors, ink/stock levels, scan normalization and typography have separate evidence and must not be merged into a whole-card calibrated flag.
Historical failed candidates remain rejected. A runtime profile can be superseded by a later source-bound study; current selectors are authoritative for application, not a quality guarantee.

missingPrintings.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

m21: White, black, multicolor and lands lack accepted source-bound pigment profiles.
Green and artifact profiles retain identity outer-frame pigment transforms; paper is adjusted.
Black and generic mana-disc targets are absent.
General land normalization does not independently certify legendary crowns or composed land tints.
8ed: Black, red, artifact and nonbasic-land pigment profiles remain absent.
White, blue and green retain identity outer-frame pigment transforms; paper is adjusted.
White, black, red and green mana-disc targets are absent.
lea: Basic and dual land pigment profiles are incomplete.
Red and blue have paper corrections with identity outer-frame pigment transforms.
leb: Green and land pigment coverage is incomplete.
Blue and black outer-frame pigment, and red paper, retain identity transforms.
3ed: Every ordinary inventory entry has some runtime pigment coverage, but black and artifact outer-frame transforms remain identity.
This does not establish complete typography, symbol, stock or full-card accuracy.

followup: Expose per-component absent/partial/accepted/failed status with evidence revision and include excluded layouts. Never label a set complete because it has a scan template or one calibrated material.
